baseline.headSubject: fix(ui): preserve provisional chase deadline limits

currentCoverageLimits.meaning: Existing green checks are real but limited; they are not corpus/stage/programme PASS.

existingSystems.title: MAA V2 registry, controls and staged calibration artefacts
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse as control authority and historical denominator evidence. Do not replace with a fresh parallel truth system.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Needs a wrapper that reports exercised/not_exercised by taxonomy and severity across future corpus tiers.

existingSystems.title: Source-truth guardians and live UI wording regressions
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse for high-value invariants: unsupported promotion, family firewall, provisional deadlines, selected-case route.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Needs a shared failure-result schema and severity classification so discoveries become comparable audit rows.

existingSystems.title: Stage-3000 parallel audit/controller libraries
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse for sharding, blinding, receipts, hashes, checkpoints, root-cause dedupe and machine-readable audit runs.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Needs connection to the current product canonical-state invariants before broad 3,000 reruns.

existingSystems.title: Accepted V2.1.2 clean single-writer diverse-3000 evidence
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse as accepted clean single-writer lineage and frozen evidence record.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Coverage limitation remains: 17/361 controls; browser not exercised; PDF lane not genuine output for all cases.

existingSystems.title: Real-PDF live pilot v1 and authenticated-preview QA lane
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse for real local production-builder path, 20 real PDFs, wording/raster checks, and entitlement/auth preview lessons.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Scale is limited: 20 matters; authenticated HTTP/browser remains not_exercised unless the user opens/authorises session.

existingSystems.title: Canonical product state / criminal workflow modules
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse and harden as source of product truth; fixes should land here only when lineage proves product-root cause.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Needs explicit canonical-state audit model for evidence state, provenance family, stage, certainty ceiling and counters.

existingSystems.title: Corpus, gold-set and historical audit materials
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse for stratification candidates and historical failure examples; do not treat generated CaseBrain output as ground truth.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Needs formal gold/holdout designation with independent truth provenance before claiming broad solicitor confidence.

existingSystems.title: Browser/rendered UI and screenshot-oriented tooling
existingSystems.reuseDecision: Reuse as provisional live/rendered evidence where sessions are available.
existingSystems.identifiedGap: Browser lane is not a substitute for deterministic source-truth auditing and remains separate from corpus PASS.

same issue duplicated or distinct issues merged
visible counters have incompatible unexplained scopes
downstream copy exceeds source certainty
internal/test/taxonomy wording leaks
rendering hides/damages trust-critical information

conflicting documents silently collapsed

severity.description: Potentially unsafe/confidentiality/fundamental truth failure; must block release until resolved or explicitly quarantined.
Serious trust/legal-meaning failure; requires root-cause review and invariant before broad claim.
Workflow/product clarity problem; fix/log without derailing P0/P1 truth work.
Cosmetic polish; route to visual redesign unless it damages meaning/trust.

machineReadableResultFormat.note: This is Phase 1 design output, not yet a full corpus run.

gaps.currentFact: Accepted V2.1.2 evidence reports 17/361 controls exercised.
gaps.needed: One canonical coverage registry that reports exercised/not_exercised/unavailable by taxonomy category and run tier.

gaps.currentFact: Existing reports use several compatible but separate STOP/receipt formats.
gaps.needed: Shared audit result envelope: runId, commit, caseId, invariantId, taxonomy, severity, surface, sourceRef, expected, actual, rootCluster.

gaps.currentFact: Cross-tab bugs are caught by specific regressions and live sweeps, not yet by a general canonical-state comparator.
gaps.needed: Programmatic comparator for Overview/Court/Papers/Client/CPS Chase/File against one canonical evidence-state model.

gaps.currentFact: There are many corpus/gold artefacts, but the next programme needs formal gold/holdout designation without using CaseBrain output as truth.
gaps.needed: Stratified Gold 150-250 and Holdout 50-100 plan with independent truth provenance and unresolved labels.

gaps.currentFact: Browser lane remains not_exercised in accepted V2.1.2; real-PDF pilot covers 20 real PDFs and local builders.
gaps.needed: Rendered UI/browser representative subset after core invariants; PDF output proof separated from source PDF copies.

gaps.currentFact: Security/tenant checks exist in scattered app tests, not yet as a master-auditor lane.
gaps.needed: Separate security auditor plan for auth, tenant isolation, signed URLs, case ID enumeration, route protection.

phase2EntryCriteria: Do not run all 3,000 PDFs yet.
Create a shared audit result model, invariant registry and severity/taxonomy enums.
Wire existing source-truth and MAA receipts into the shared envelope.
Use a small development sample only until result model and coverage accounting are proven.
